DocsOverview.title: Source code overview
DocsOverview.description: A quick map of this Next.js 16 template: stack, main folders, and conventions for extending it.
DocsOverview.foldersIntro: Each folder has one clear job. Keep logic in the right layer.

folders.app: App Router — layouts, pages, error, not-found under [locale]
folders.fetches: HTTP helpers for CMS / Rank Math / CF7

DocsOverview.c1: default vi, prefix as-needed — / is Vietnamese, /en is English.
DocsOverview.c2: always use Link/useRouter from @/i18n/navigation, not raw next/link.

DocsHow.title: How the source works
DocsHow.description: Request flow, i18n, data layer, and how to add a new page in this template.
DocsHow.requestIntro: Every URL passes through these layers before the page renders.
DocsHow.i18n1: Config lives in src/i18n/routing.ts — locales vi/en, defaultLocale vi.
DocsHow.i18n2: Page files use the internal path: app/[locale]/gioi-thieu/. English public URL is /en/about via pathnames.
DocsHow.i18n3: messages/vi.json and en.json are loaded in src/i18n/request.ts.

data.fetches: fetchData() hits ENV.CMS + ENV.API + endpoint; Rank Math / CF7 helpers are separate.
data.services: e.g. tourService wraps an endpoint and returns data to the page.
data.consume: Server Components await the service, or Clients use TanStack Query.

DocsHow.providers3: Drawer/Sheet providers: controlled wrappers — mount when needed, not globally.
DocsHow.add2: Add a pathname in routing.ts (and ROUTES if needed).
DocsHow.add3: Add copy to messages/vi.json and messages/en.json.
DocsHow.add4: Link with @/i18n/navigation using the internal pathname key.
